name: Eye of Kimbul adds one percent ranged auto-attack crit per stack on its affected target and keeps its DBC debuff text (#6979, #7388)
contract: Eye of Kimbul debuff 802707 (effect 0 aura 271 MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER, MiscValue 127; effect 1 aura 308
SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_CHANCE_FOR_CASTER, 1% per stack, StackAmount 5, Spell.dbc DurationIndex 8) must raise the Witch
Doctor's critical chance for ranged auto-attacks against that target by exactly the stack count, and nothing else.
The reporter saw 100% crit on ranged auto-attacks with five stacks; the expected value is the baseline plus five.
The assertions here bound the absolute chance as well as the delta, so a baseline that is already wrong - which a
delta-only test cannot see - fails the scenario instead of passing it.
The debuff's own aura text (Spell.dbc ToolTip) reports the current per-stack effect. A published
coa_client_spell_description row replaced it with a static text that players read as the talent description
(#7388), so the login patch stream must not publish row 802707 and the client renders its DBC text.
Confirmed unrelated: the Pain rows 706643 and 706664 carry a 100% aura 308 and are applied by nothing in the core.

steps.label: CONTROL: the login patch stream captures the shared description table at all (Runeshroud's own row)
Eye of Kimbul 802707 has no published row, so the debuff shows its own stack-scaled DBC aura text
The unbuffed ranged crit chance is a normal value, nowhere near 100
Learning the Eye of Kimbul passive alone adds no ranged crit
Learning the Eye of Kimbul passive leaves the absolute ranged crit chance sane
One stack adds one percent ranged crit against the affected target
One stack leaves the absolute ranged crit chance sane
Five stacks add five percent ranged crit (crit pipeline residual is ~0.0003), not 100
Five stacks leave the absolute ranged crit chance sane, not 100
The debuff adds nothing against another enemy
An enemy without the debuff sees no ranged crit leak
The spell crit path sees no leak either
